description: Soul Link Talent 20% of base mana 100 yd range Instant Requires Warlock Requires level 1 When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.
name: Soul Link
